news.title: Internationals: Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli scores hat-trick as Blues star for England
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利作为英格兰蓝军球星上演帽子戏法
news.body_en: Our Young Blues were in fine form today for England across several youth age groups, as six players registered goal contributions, including a hat-trick from 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli. At midday, Chizaram Ezenwata started in attack as England Under-19s beat Slovenia 4-1 and claimed the assist for the opening goal. Reggie Walsh also featured in the starting XI, while Freddy Bernal and Landon Emanalo were among the substitutes. Nicoll-Jazuli, Reggie Watson and Josh Henry all started in England Under-17s' 6-1 win over Montenegro. Watson captained the side in Austria and claimed an assist, but it was Nicoll-Jazuli who made the biggest mark on the game with a hat-trick and an assist, before coming off just after an hour. Our Blues were also prominent in England’s 3-2 victory against the Netherlands, as Riley Ebho scored the winner in a five-goal thriller. His goal came just seven minutes after being brought on. Ryan Kavuma-McQueen - currently on loan at Portsmouth - scored the opening goal of that game with a rifled strike into the top-left corner. Looking ahead, the next Blue set to be involved in international action is Jacob Hall, who has been called up for the USA's Under-20s side. Their next game against Japan kicks off on Thursday 12 November at 1am UK time.
news.body_zh: 今天，我们的年轻蓝军在英格兰的多个青年组中表现出色，六名球员贡献了进球，其中包括 16 岁的迈赫迪·尼科尔·贾祖利 (Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli) 的帽子戏法。中午，奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔（Chizaram Ezenwata）首发进攻，帮助英格兰U-19队4-1击败斯洛文尼亚队，并助攻首开纪录。雷吉·沃尔什也在首发阵容中出场，而弗雷迪·伯纳尔和兰登·埃马纳洛则在替补席上。尼科尔-贾祖利、雷吉·沃森和约什·亨利都在英格兰 17 岁以下国家队 6-1 战胜黑山的比赛中首发出场。沃森在奥地利作为队长并获得了一次助攻，但尼科尔-贾祖利在比赛中上演了帽子戏法和一次助攻，在比赛一小时后就下场，表现最为出色。我们的蓝军在英格兰 3-2 战胜荷兰的比赛中也表现出色，莱利·埃博 (Riley Ebho) 打进了五球惊心动魄的制胜球。他在上场后仅仅七分钟就进球了。目前租借到朴茨茅斯的瑞恩·卡武马·麦奎因在比赛中射入左上角，取得了首个进球。展望未来，下一位参与国际比赛的蓝军球员是雅各布·霍尔（Jacob Hall），他已被美国20岁以下青年队征召入伍。他们下一场对阵日本的比赛将于英国时间 11 月 12 日星期四凌晨 1 点开始。

news.title: Internationals: The five key stories to follow
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：接下来的五个关键故事
news.body_en: As a number of the Chelsea players head off to join up with their national teams this week, we take a look at the big stories to keep an eye on during this international window. It is a more familiar, shorter, international break in November, following the new extended window introduced last month. There is still plenty going on, though, with several nations rebuilding under new management and Blues in contention to make debuts. Here is what you need to know to follow the key stories involving Chelsea players during this international break… It is impossible for Portugal to avoid the big story in their camp for this window – that they will be without long-serving captain and all-time leading scorer Cristiano Ronaldo, who announced his retirement from international football last week. The two Blues in their squad for November are at very different stages of their own international careers, but will both be looking to play their part in Portugal’s new-look, post-Ronaldo attack. Pedro Neto is one of the experienced, established attackers in the team hoping to fill the gap left by Ronaldo, both in terms of impact on the pitch and leadership. At the other end of the scale is Geovany Quenda, previously a regular for Portugal at youth level, hoping to make his first senior appearance as part of the next generation auditioning to take up the reins. Belgium are another country who will be without one of their experienced regulars, in former Chelsea goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who has opted to sit out this Nations League campaign after a series of injuries. That has resulted in a shootout between the other goalkeepers to stake a claim for this tournament and the right to challenge Courtois for the No1 spot on his return. With some strong performances under his belt in the Premier League over the last month, Mike Penders is now hoping to follow up his debut in that competition with another for his national team. Argentina are one of several countries undergoing something of a rebuild after this year’s World Cup, although without a change in management, as Lionel Scaloni looks to inject some youth into his side after the international retirement of Lionel Messi. Among that younger generation looking to impress Scaloni to play an important part in Argentina’s future are 22-year-old Valentin Barco and 21-year-old Aaron Anselmino. Barco already has seven caps to his name, but Anselmino has been called up to the senior squad for the first time. At the other end of the scale is Emiliano Martinez. The goalkeeper is one of Argentina’s most experienced players and a veteran of their 2022 World Cup-winning campaign. After being named on the bench for Chelsea against Sunderland, he could make his return to the pitch following surgery on a fractured jaw during this international window. As well as a crucial couple of games for their Nations League campaign, which could conclude with an effective play-off against Belgium for a place in the quarter-finals, the most important thing for Italy at the moment is to steady the ship after repeated failures to reach the World Cup. That means returning manager Roberto Mancini’s focus is very much on the future. As a result, it is a notably young squad selected for this international window, with only three outfield players over the age of 27. That is a serious departure for a team which has traditionally relied heavily on experience. Among the young contingent is Marco Palestra, returning to the squad following injury for the first time since making his international debut in March. Anselmino isn’t the only Chelsea player meeting up with their national team for the first time in November. After being fast-tracked through the youth ranks in Sweden, Genesis Antwi has been selected by Graham Potter, just one year after making his debut for their Under-21s. Having impressed on loan with Strasbourg so far this season – his first full-time campaign in senior football – Antwi now has his sights set on a senior international debut as Sweden aim to seal promotion to the top tier of the Nations League.
news.body_zh: 随着本周许多切尔西球员前往与国家队会合，我们来看看这个国际比赛窗口期间需要关注的重大新闻。继上个月推出新的延长窗口期之后，这是 11 月份的一个更熟悉、更短的国际假期。不过，还有很多事情正在发生，一些国家在新的管理层下进行重建，蓝军也在争夺首次亮相。以下是您需要了解的内容，以便在国际比赛日期间关注切尔西球员的关键故事……葡萄牙队不可能避免在这个窗口期发生在他们的阵营中的大新闻——他们将失去长期担任队长和历史最佳射手的克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多，他上周宣布从国际足坛退役。十一月阵容中的两支蓝军正处于各自国家队职业生涯的不同阶段，但两人都希望在葡萄牙队后罗纳尔多时代的新进攻中发挥自己的作用。佩德罗·内托是球队中经验丰富、实力雄厚的攻击手之一，希望能够填补罗纳尔多留下的空缺，无论是在球场影响力还是领导力方面。另一端是乔瓦尼·昆达(Geovany Quenda)，他曾是葡萄牙青年队的常客，希望在下一代试镜中首次亮相成年队。比利时是另一个将缺席经验丰富主力的国家，前切尔西门将蒂博·库尔图瓦在经历一系列伤病后选择缺席本次欧国联比赛。这导致了其他门将之间的点球大战，以争夺本届赛事的参赛权，并在库尔图瓦回归后挑战第一名的权利。迈克·潘德斯上个月在英超联赛中表现出色，现在他希望能在自己的国家队首秀之后再次亮相。阿根廷是今年世界杯后经历重建的几个国家之一，尽管管理层没有发生变化，因为莱昂内尔·斯卡罗尼在梅西退役后希望为他的球队注入一些年轻人。 22 岁的瓦伦丁·巴科 (Valentin Barco) 和 21 岁的亚伦·安塞尔米诺 (Aaron Anselmino) 是希望给斯卡罗尼留下深刻印象并在阿根廷的未来中发挥重要作用的年轻一代。巴科已经代表球队出场七次，但安塞尔米诺却首次入选成年队。天平的另一端是埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯。这位门将是阿根廷最有经验的球员之一，也是 2022 年世界杯夺冠的老将。在切尔西对阵桑德兰的比赛中被任命为替补后，他可能会在国际比赛窗口期间接受下巴骨折手术后重返球场。除了欧国联征程中的几场关键比赛（可能会与比利时进行一场有效的附加赛，争夺四分之一决赛席位）之外，对于意大利来说，目前最重要的事情是在多次未能进入世界杯后稳定住球队。这意味着回归主帅罗伯托·曼奇尼的重点是未来。因此，这次国际比赛的阵容非常年轻，只有三名27岁以上的外场球员。对于一支传统上严重依赖经验的球队来说，这是一个严重的背离。马尔科·帕莱斯特拉（Marco Palestra）就是年轻球员中的一员，他自三月份完成国家队首秀以来，在受伤后首次重返球队。安塞尔米诺并不是唯一一位在 11 月份首次与国家队会面的切尔西球员。在瑞典青年队中快速晋级后，Genesis Antwi 被格雷厄姆·波特选中，此时距离他在 21 岁以下国家队首次亮相仅一年。本赛季到目前为止，安特维被租借到斯特拉斯堡，这是他在成年足球联赛中的第一次全职比赛，给人留下了深刻的印象，现在他的目标是在国家队首秀，因为瑞典的目标是晋级国家联赛顶级联赛。

news.title: Bjorn on a good performance just missing a goal
news.title_zh: 比约恩表现出色，只是错过了一个进球
news.body_en: Nathalie Bjorn was pleased with Chelsea’s overall performance and couldn’t fault our effort away at Hacken in the UEFA Women’s Champions League, but gave our opposition credit for the way they defended stubbornly to deny us the winning goal she felt we deserved. The Blues ended Tuesday’s game with a huge 78 per cent share of the possession and managed 20 shots over the 90 minutes. Two of those struck the woodwork and another two found the back of the net, only for both goals to be ruled out by the officials. In the end, despite dominating, Chelsea travelled back to England with just the one point to show for our efforts following a 0-0 draw in Sweden. That was still enough for third place in the table, though, with the Blues undefeated after four games of the league phase and yet to concede a goal in Europe this season. The result left Swedish international defender Bjorn with mixed feelings after having to settle for a point on her return to her homeland. ‘It was a tough game,’ she said. ‘I think we had a good performance but they defended really well. We knew we would have a lot of possession and Hacken are good defensively. ‘We spoke about it, worked on it during the week, but they defended really well. I think we created enough chances to score a goal, but we couldn’t do that this time. We had massive possession, but couldn’t convert the chances. ‘They’re a hard-working team. Swedish teams are known for working really hard defensively and they really proved that. They put bodies on the line, they fought for each other and you could really see the team effort out there. ‘I think we struggled with that. We tried. We really, really tried. But unfortunately we couldn’t score a goal.’ That was despite a notable improvement in the second half, with Bjorn explaining they spent the break discussing the changes needed to improve our chances of victory, even if it wasn’t quite enough in the end. ‘We had a hard time creating some scoring chances, but I think we did, especially in the second half. It was about having more patience in our positions after half-time and I think we did a good performance, but we just couldn't score a goal. ‘We spoke a bit at half-time, to have more players in the box, and I think we did that better in the second half. We had more patience in our possession to see where the spaces were because there were spaces we could play. ‘So I think we played better in the second half, but we just need to be more clinical.’ After back-to-back draws with Everton and Hacken, that need to be more clinical in front of goal is something Bjorn and her Blues team-mates are eager to put right before our next match – a massive top-of-the-table clash in the Women’s Super League against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge. ‘We said we just need to stick together, and we still did a great game. Of course we want to win, we want to have the three points, that was our aim before the game. Sometimes that doesn’t happen, but I think we did a good enough performance to get those three points. ‘It’s just that we couldn’t score the goal, so we just need to take the positives from this game and then bring that in for the game against Manchester City. We just need to sharpen up a little bit and be ready for City this weekend.’ Tickets for Saturday's huge game remain on sale!
news.body_zh: 纳塔莉·比约恩对切尔西的整体表现感到满意，她对我们在女足冠军联赛客场对阵哈肯的比赛中的表现无可挑剔，但她也赞扬了我们的对手，因为他们顽强的防守阻止了我们取得她认为我们应得的制胜进球。蓝军以 78% 的控球率结束了周二的比赛，并在 90 分钟内射门 20 次。其中两球击中门框，另外两球射入球门，但两个进球均被裁判判定无效。最终，尽管切尔西取得了统治地位，但在0-0战平瑞典后，我们只拿到一分回到英格兰。不过，这仍然足以排名第三，蓝军在联赛阶段的四场比赛后保持不败，并且本赛季在欧洲尚未失球。这一结果让瑞典国脚后卫比约恩在回到祖国后不得不满足于一分，心情复杂。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，”她说。 “我认为我们表现不错，但他们防守得很好。我们知道我们会拥有很多控球权，而且哈肯的防守也很好。 “我们讨论过这个问题，并在一周内进行了努力，但他们的防守非常好。我认为我们创造了足够的进球机会，但这次我们没能做到。我们拥有大量控球权，但无法转化机会。 ‘他们是一支勤奋的团队。瑞典球队以防守非常努力而闻名，他们也确实证明了这一点。他们冒着生命危险，为彼此而战，你可以真正看到团队的努力。 “我认为我们为此苦苦挣扎。我们尝试过。我们真的真的很努力。但不幸的是我们没能进球。”尽管下半场有了显着的进步，比约恩解释说，他们在中场休息时讨论了提高我们胜利机会所需的改变，即使最终还不够。 “我们很难创造一些得分机会，但我认为我们做到了，尤其是在下半场。这是关于半场结束后我们的位置要有更多的耐心，我认为我们表现不错，但我们就是无法进球。 “我们在中场休息时说了一些话，希望禁区里有更多的球员，我认为我们在下半场做得更好。我们有更多的耐心来查看空间在哪里，因为那里有我们可以玩的空间。 “所以我认为我们下半场踢得更好，但我们只需要更加冷静。”在连续战平埃弗顿和哈肯之后，比约恩和她的蓝军队友们渴望在下一场比赛之前在球门前更加冷静——这是一场在斯坦福桥对阵曼城的女足超级联赛顶级联赛的大规模交锋。 “我们说过我们只需要团结在一起，但我们仍然踢了一场精彩的比赛。我们当然想要赢球，我们想要全取三分，这是我们赛前的目标。有时这种情况不会发生，但我认为我们的表现足够好，可以得到这三分。 “只是我们无法进球，所以我们只需要从这场比赛中汲取积极的东西，然后将其带入对阵曼城的比赛中。”我们只需要稍微加强一下，为本周末对阵曼城的比赛做好准备。周六大型比赛的门票仍在销售中！

news.title: Remembering Vivian Woodward – the amateur and gentleman who sacrificed for others
news.title_zh: 纪念维维安·伍德沃德——一位为他人牺牲的业余爱好者和绅士
news.body_en: We continue marking Remembrance Day by celebrating the great Vivian Woodward, who led by example on and off the pitch… When Vivian ‘John’ Woodward died aged 74 in an Ealing nursing home following two years of illness, veteran football writers were quick to acclaim the man who had just slipped the sporting coil. Many described Woodward as one of England’s greatest players, international team-mate Bob Steel recalling ‘the finest centre-forward I have ever seen. A great gentleman on and off the field … I never saw him commit a foul or retaliate – and he took some pastings.’ As a committed amateur with a thriving architectural business, Woodward never claimed a penny from the sport he graced, even the expenses legitimately available to players in his position. That same status enabled him to compete with Great Britain in Olympics – and he won football golds in 1908 and 1912. For the first of those he was a Tottenham squad member, but from November 1909 he was the outstanding star of the recently-formed Chelsea team. ‘The most cheering news we have had during our time of desolation is the intimation that Vivian John Woodward is going to assist Chelsea,’ the Chelsea Chronicle wrote when he signed. ‘Had the great Vivian been a professional player his transfer fee, I fancy, would have been something near a record one. ‘Instead, Woodward comes to us for love, and we may take it that he is already the idol of Stamford Bridge. Vivian Woodward has been and ever will be the people’s favourite. Small wonder. Great as he is as a player, his first claim to popularity lies in the fact that he has ever been first and foremost a gentleman. ‘I question if any footballer has ever been so universally popular, and he carries his honours with the air of a bashful debutant.’ Tall, lithe, his wavy hair slightly receding, the England captain soon became the darling of the Stamford Bridge terracing, netting an impressive 34 goals in 116 appearances for the Blues over six seasons, despite the club’s ups and downs. After the outbreak of World War One in August 1914, like many of his colleagues Woodward answered his country’s call and joined the Army, eventually taking a commission and rising to Captain in the Footballers’ Battalion. Remembrance today means taking a moment to reflect on the personal sacrifice made by so many millions in the face of the unprecedented horrors of 1914-18. To his enormous credit Woodward also made the ultimate act of selflessness in football. On 20 February 1915, then Lieutenant Woodward barked the marching orders to his uniformed men as they paraded the pitch ahead of a round three match between QPR and Everton hosted at Stamford Bridge. Woodward’s participation in football – which carried on as normal for one season – was curtailed by his war service in England (he would not embark overseas until late 1915), and after 29 starts the previous season he was available for just six games, scoring three times, in 1914/15. Significantly, he played no part in the FA Cup campaign as Chelsea roared to the final in April 1915 – the first Football League club from London to do so. Instead, prolific Chelsea-schooled centre-forward Bob Thomson filled his boots in the competition with five goals – including the winner at Man City in round three. Critically, Thomson, who remarkably had the use of only one eye, was sidelined a few weeks after Chelsea beat Everton 2-0 in the semi-final at Villa Park. The final, removed to Old Trafford due to wartime travel restrictions, loomed into view with Thompson working to recover and Woodward suddenly available. Then, as now, the FA Cup showpiece was the dream of any footballer and the opportunity of playing one was all too rare and precious in any career. But when offered the chance to play in place of Thompson, who had barely recovered from his injury, Woodward announced that his fellow striker was the one who had done most to lead Chelsea to the final, and he should be the man to have the honour of representing the Blues on 24 April in Manchester. In the event the so-called ‘Khaki final’ did not go well for David Calderhead’s team – Sheffield United ran out easy 3-0 victors. The player who came to Stamford Bridge ‘for love’ in 1909 was injured in battle and retired from football by the time the Football League returned in 1919, but from 1922 to 1930 he would play another key role as director of the club. Then, until his death a quarter-of-a-century later, Woodward was out of the game – but always remembered for the principled way he approached life and the sport as much as for the brilliance of his stellar career.
news.body_zh: 我们继续纪念阵亡将士纪念日，庆祝伟大的维维安·伍德沃德，她在场上和场下都以身作则……当维维安·“约翰”·伍德沃德在患病两年后在伊灵一家疗养院去世，享年 74 岁时，资深足球作家很快就向这位刚刚滑落运动线圈的人表示赞扬。许多人将伍德沃德描述为英格兰最伟大的球员之一，国际队友鲍勃·斯蒂尔回忆道“他是我见过的最优秀的中锋”。场上场下都是一位伟大的绅士……我从未见过他犯规或报复——而且他还吃了一些东西。”作为一名拥有蓬勃发展的建筑业务的忠诚的业余爱好者，伍德沃德从未从他所赋予的这项运动中索要一分钱，甚至包括处于他位置的球员合法可以使用的费用。同样的身份使他能够与英国队一起参加奥运会，并于 1908 年和 1912 年赢得了足球金牌。第一次时，他是托特纳姆热刺队的成员，但从 1909 年 11 月开始，他成为新组建的切尔西队的杰出明星。 “在我们的荒凉时期，我们得到的最令人振奋的消息是维维安·约翰·伍德沃德将协助切尔西的暗示，”《切尔西纪事报》在他签约时写道。 “我想，如果伟大的维维安成为一名职业球员，他的转会费将接近创纪录的水平。 “相反，伍德沃德来找我们是为了爱，我们可以认为他已经是斯坦福桥的偶像了。维维安·伍德沃德一直是并且永远都是人们的最爱。没什么奇怪的。尽管他作为一名球员很出色，但他之所以受欢迎的首要原因在于他首先是一位绅士。 “我怀疑是否有哪位足球运动员如此受到普遍欢迎，而他却以羞涩的新人姿态承载着自己的荣誉。”这位英格兰队长身材高大、轻盈，卷发微微后退，很快成为斯坦福桥球场的宠儿，尽管俱乐部经历了起起落落，但他在 6 个赛季为蓝军出场 116 场比赛中打进了 34 粒进球，令人印象深刻。 1914 年 8 月第一次世界大战爆发后，伍德沃德像他的许多同事一样响应国家号召参军，最终接受委任并晋升为足球运动员营上尉。今天的纪念意味着花点时间反思数百万人在 1914-18 年空前的恐怖面前所做出的个人牺牲。值得赞扬的是，伍德沃德在足球界也做出了无私的终极举动。 1915 年 2 月 20 日，女王公园巡游者队 (QPR) 与埃弗顿队 (Everton) 在斯坦福桥 (Stamford Bridge) 举行第三轮比赛之前，当时的中尉伍德沃德 (Woodward) 在球场上游行时向他的身穿制服的士兵发出了行军命令。伍德沃德参加足球比赛的时间正常进行了一个赛季，但由于他在英格兰服役而受到限制（他直到 1915 年底才踏上海外之旅），在上个赛季 29 场首发后，他在 1914/15 赛季只参加了 6 场比赛，攻入 3 球。值得注意的是，他并没有参加 1915 年 4 月切尔西队闯入决赛的足总杯比赛——这是第一支做到这一点的伦敦足球联赛俱乐部。相反，多产的切尔西出身中锋鲍勃·汤姆森在比赛中打进了五个进球，其中包括第三轮对阵曼城的制胜球。至关重要的是，在维拉公园半决赛中，切尔西以 2-0 击败埃弗顿后几周，汤姆森就因只能用一只眼睛而缺席比赛。由于战时旅行限制而移师老特拉福德的决赛迫在眉睫，汤普森正在努力恢复，伍德沃德突然可以上场。当时和现在一样，参加足总杯比赛是所有足球运动员的梦想，而参加足总杯比赛的机会在任何职业生涯中都非常罕见和珍贵。但当伍德沃德有机会代替伤势刚刚恢复的汤普森上场时，他宣布他的前锋同伴是带领切尔西进入决赛做出最大贡献的人，他应该是有幸代表蓝军参加4月24日曼彻斯特比赛的人。然而，所谓的“卡其色决赛”对大卫·卡尔德黑德的球队来说并不顺利——谢菲尔德联队以 3-0 轻松获胜。这位 1909 年“为爱”来到斯坦福桥的球员在战斗中受伤，并在 1919 年足球联赛回归时退役，但从 1922 年到 1930 年，他作为俱乐部董事扮演了另一个关键角色。 然后，直到四分之一世纪后去世，伍德沃德退出了比赛，但人们永远记得他对待生活和这项运动的原则性方式以及他辉煌的​​职业生涯。

news.title: Lucy Bronze: We need to be more ruthless
news.title_zh: 露西·布朗兹：我们需要更加无情
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze reflected on a frustrating night in Sweden as the Blues were held to a goalless draw by Hacken in the UEFA Women's Champions League, with the defender now turning her attention to this weend’s crucial clash against Manchester City. Sonia Bompastor's side dominated possession and territory throughout, but were unable to break down a resolute Hacken defence. Bronze hit the crossbar in the first half, while both Melvine Malard and Wieke Kaptein had goals ruled out for offside on a night where the Blues created plenty of opportunities without finding the decisive breakthrough. Speaking after the final whistle, Bronze acknowledged that Chelsea needed to show more sharpness in the final third to turn dominance into three points. ‘We probably didn’t do enough in front of the goal to get the ball and to get the win, and Hacken defended really, really well,’ said Bronze. ‘They threw their bodies at the ball all the time. We just needed to be quicker and more slick on the ball, and more ruthless in front of goal, from corners, when we got the chance to take a shot. You need to kill teams when you have so much possession and you dominate the game. ‘Hacken worked really hard. Their game plan worked really well. They were set up to get that point. It is difficult to break a team down, but we can do better than that, and we should be winning games like that.’ With a relentless schedule across domestic and European competitions, the Blues have no time to dwell on Wednesday's result as attention shifts straight back to the Women's Super League. Chelsea host title rivals Manchester City on Saturday, giving Bronze and her team-mates a chance to bounce back immediately in another high-profile fixture. ‘We have a big game coming up in the next couple of days,’ said Bronze. ‘We just recover and we go again like we have all season. We've had different results all season, and it's a long season as well. ‘We know in the league and in the Champions League, as long as we're still up there with all the big teams, that's what we want at this time of season. And we know that we're still there.’ Tickets for Saturday's huge game remain on sale!
news.body_zh: 露西·布朗兹回忆了在瑞典度过的一个令人沮丧的夜晚，当时蓝军在欧洲女子冠军联赛中被哈肯0比0逼平，这位后卫现在将注意力转向了本周末对阵曼城的关键比赛。索尼娅·邦帕斯特的球队自始至终都控制着控球权和地盘，但无法打破哈肯的坚决防守。布隆泽在上半场击中横梁，而梅尔文·马拉德和维克·卡普坦的进球均因越位而被判无效，蓝军创造了大量机会，但没有找到决定性的突破。终场哨声吹响后，布朗兹承认切尔西需要在最后三区表现出更多的犀利，才能将统治力转化为三分。 “我们可能在球门前做得不够，无法拿到球并赢得胜利，而哈肯的防守非常非常好，”布朗兹说。 “他们一直用身体扑向球。我们只需要在控球时更快、更灵活，当我们有机会射门时，在球门前、角球处更加无情。当你拥有如此多的控球权并统治比赛时，你需要杀死球队。 “哈肯工作非常努力。他们的比赛计划非常有效。他们就是为了达到这一点而设立的。击垮一支球队是很困难的，但我们可以做得更好，我们应该赢得这样的比赛。”由于国内和欧洲比赛的日程安排得非常紧，蓝军没有时间去关注周三的结果，因为注意力直接转移回了女超联赛。切尔西周六主场迎战争冠对手曼城，这给了布朗兹和她的队友们在另一场备受瞩目的比赛中立即反弹的机会。 “接下来的几天我们将有一场重要的比赛，”布隆泽说道。 “我们刚刚恢复过来，然后我们就会像整个赛季一样再次出发。我们整个赛季都取得了不同的结果，而且这也是一个漫长的赛季。 `我们知道在联赛和冠军联赛中，只要我们仍然与所有强队保持同步，这就是我们在赛季这个时候想要的。我们知道我们还在那里。”周六大型比赛的门票仍在销售！

news.title: Remembering James Ridley - the Chelsea ballboy who served with Blues greats
news.title_zh: 纪念詹姆斯·里德利——曾与蓝军伟大球员一起服役的切尔西球童
news.body_en: This Remembrance Day we tell the story of James Ridley, who served during the First World War and was a well-known figure in the locality of Stamford Bridge for 70 years… Whether it was purchasing his favourite sweet pipe tobacco with a cheery chat at the corner newsagent, or offering his services as a pianist to a women’s group that met in the church, James Ridley always had a tale to tell. When his family caught sight of granddad Jim tinkling the ivories in the church or neighbourhood pub, he seemed transported – eyes glazed, lost in a faraway world. What the listening ladies and evening drinkers might not have known was that Jim had a fascinating life story that of wartime trauma and childhood history-making – all centred around Chelsea Football Club. In 1905, a notice appeared on the gates of the old London Athletic Grounds seeking small boys to fetch the ball when it was hit into the space behind the goals created by the oval athletics track. Chelsea FC were coming to Stamford Bridge and one of the successful young applicants for the new role was Jim, who lived at 7 Stamford Road – opposite the Bridge. He would become one of football’s first ballboys and can be seen on the right of one of the earliest first team photographs, above, taken in September 1905. He had just reached his teens at the time and goalkeeper Willie Foulke – whose stamina the ballboys preserved with their fetching and carrying – would sometimes playfully take him off the field under an arm. Whether he was paid or how much is not known, but the privilege of being at close-quarters to his heroes made Jim a lifelong fan of the club. So much so that in January 1915, a few months after World War One had broken out, Jim – now a 23-year-old labourer a shade over 5ft 5in– volunteered for the recently formed ‘Footballers’ Battalion’ – the 17th Middlesex. He saw it as honour to live, train and fight not just alongside other fans, but many current and former Chelsea players. They included England skipper Vivian ‘Jack’ Woodward, wing-half George Lake, wingers Teddy Foord and Norman Wood, full-back Dave Girdwood, goalkeeper William Krug, legendary all-round sportsman Max Woosnam, and Foulke’s successor at the Bridge, Bob ‘Pom Pom’ Whiting. If you can’t be them, join them seems to have been his maxim, but such commitment came at a price. At the height of the bloody conflict in June 1916, his unit - now part of the 6th Brigade of the 2nd Division of the British Army – found themselves on the frontline, suffering some casualties. The media back home commended the Footballers’ Battalion for their bravery, but the worst was yet to come – including the living hell of the infamous First Battle of the Somme in July 1916, where so many friends were killed or hospitalised. Jim survived, but on 30 November 1917, in the Battle of Cambrai, he was captured by German troops near Inchy. This was where tanks were first truly effective, breaking through the supposedly impregnable Hindenburg Line. Back home, his heartbroken family initially only heard he was ‘missing in action’. Their torment was ended when the Red Cross reported him a prisoner of war at Lager Dulmen. There he would remain until after the war ended by the Armistice at the 11th hour of the 11th day of the 11th month in 1918. During his 18-month incarceration, guards learned of Jim’s ability on the piano and encouraged him to play one in the camp mess hall as it improved prisoner morale. He was eventually repatriated to Britain on 14 March 1919, returning to civilian life at Stamford Road – and to matches at his beloved Bridge. Playing piano around the area for people’s entertainment was part of the way he dealt with his memories of war. In later life, he would recall what an honour it had been to serve alongside the Chelsea stars – despite the horror of the trenches and darkness of brutal confinement, where forced labour in coal mines was routine. Though always smartly turned-out with a waistcoat and fob-watch, like many ex-soldiers Jim suffered hard times and sadly had to sell his war medals. The ballboy pioneer turned pipe-smoking pianist remained an ardent Blues supporter right up to his death, witnessing the club’s successes in 1955, 1965, 1970 and 1971. Jim died in July 1975, 60 years after joining up to serve King, Country… and Chelsea.
news.body_zh: 在这个阵亡将士纪念日，我们讲述詹姆斯·里德利的故事，他在第一次世界大战期间服役，70年来一直是斯坦福桥当地的知名人物……无论是在街角报刊亭一边愉快地聊天一边购买他最喜欢的甜烟丝，还是作为钢琴家为在教堂聚会的妇女团体提供服务，詹姆斯·里德利总是有一个故事要讲。当他的家人看到爷爷吉姆在教堂或附近的酒吧里敲响象牙时，他似乎很着迷——目光呆滞，迷失在遥远的世界中。倾听的女士们和晚间饮酒者可能不知道的是，吉姆有一个引人入胜的人生故事，讲述了战时创伤和童年历史的创造——所有这些都以切尔西足球俱乐部为中心。 1905 年，老伦敦运动场的大门上贴出了一张告示，当球击中椭圆形田径场球门后面的空间时，请小男孩将球捡起来。切尔西足球俱乐部即将来到斯坦福桥，吉姆是新职位的成功年轻申请人之一，他住在斯坦福桥对面的斯坦福路 7 号。他后来成为足球界最早的球童之一，可以在上图最早的一线队照片之一的右侧看到他，拍摄于 1905 年 9 月。当时他才十几岁，守门员威利·福克斯（球童通过接球和抱球保持了他的耐力）有时会开玩笑地用胳膊把他带离球场。他是否获得报酬或多少钱不得而知，但近距离接触他的英雄的特权使吉姆成为了俱乐部的终生球迷。以至于在 1915 年 1 月，第一次世界大战爆发几个月后，吉姆——现在是一名 23 岁的劳工，身高超过 5 英尺 5 英寸——志愿加入了最近组建的“足球运动员营”——米德尔塞克斯第 17 营。他认为不仅与其他球迷一起生活、训练和战斗，而且与许多现任和前任切尔西球员一起生活、训练和战斗是一种荣幸。他们包括英格兰队队长维维安·“杰克”·伍德沃德、边锋乔治·莱克、边锋泰迪·福德和诺曼·伍德、后卫戴夫·格德伍德、门将威廉·克鲁格、传奇全能运动员马克斯·伍斯南，以及福尔克在桥上的继任者鲍勃·“Pom Pom”怀廷。如果你不能成为他们，那就加入他们似乎是他的座右铭，但这种承诺是有代价的。 1916 年 6 月，血腥冲突最激烈时，他所在的部队（现隶属英国陆军第二师第六旅）发现自己身处前线，遭受了一些伤亡。国内媒体赞扬了足球运动员营的英勇行为，但最糟糕的情况尚未到来，包括 1916 年 7 月臭名昭著的第一次索姆河战役中的人间地狱，当时许多朋友被杀或住院。吉姆幸存下来，但在 1917 年 11 月 30 日的康布雷战役中，他在因奇附近被德军俘虏。这是坦克第一次真正发挥作用的地方，突破了据说坚不可摧的兴登堡防线。回到家后，他伤心欲绝的家人最初只听说他“在行动中失踪”。当红十字会报告他成为拉格杜尔门的战俘时，他们的折磨结束了。他一直呆在那里，直到 1918 年 11 月 11 日 11 点停战协议结束。在他 18 个月的监禁期间，看守了解到吉姆的钢琴才能，并鼓励他在集中营食堂弹奏一架，以提高囚犯的士气。他最终于 1919 年 3 月 14 日被遣返回英国，回到斯坦福路的平民生活，并前往他心爱的大桥观看比赛。在该地区弹钢琴供人们娱乐是他处理战争记忆的方式之一。在后来的生活中，他会回忆起与切尔西球星一起服役是多么的荣幸——尽管战壕里的恐怖和残酷监禁的黑暗，煤矿里的强迫劳动是家常便饭。尽管吉姆总是穿着背心和手表，但像许多退伍军人一样，吉姆也经历了艰难的时期，并遗憾地不得不卖掉他的战争奖章。这位从球童先驱转型为烟斗钢琴家的蓝军直到去世前仍然是蓝调的热心支持者，见证了俱乐部在 1955 年、1965 年、1970 年和 1971 年的成功。吉姆于 1975 年 7 月去世，距他为国王、乡村……和切尔西效力 60 年后。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor: 'We need to refocus and move on'
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特：“我们需要重新集中注意力并继续前进”
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor felt her side were unfortunate not to come away from Hacken with a win after the Swedish side held us to a stalemate, but stressed the importance of moving on quickly with Saturday's important clash against Manchester City on the horizon. The Blues did everything but score at the Hisingen Arena, hitting the woodwork twice, having two goals ruled out and firing in a total of 32 shots, as Hacken goalkeeper Jennifer Falk was awarded the Player of the Match trophy for making five crucial saves. Defensively, we kept our fourth clean sheet in four league phase matches in the competition, but this was an evening when we were unfortunate not to come away with all three points. Yet there were some positives for the head coach to take, on a night when the defence was solid once again in the Women's Champions League. 'Tonight’s performance was good in terms of the defensive aspects,' Bompastor reflected. 'We knew what they wanted to do against us: they wanted to use the transition to hurt us behind the backline, and the defenders dealt really well with those situations. 'We were dominant with the ball for most of the game. We created a lot of opportunities, but tonight we couldn’t score the one goal to win the game. It’s a frustrating result. We came here with the ambition to win. 'We also hit the crossbar, and the goalkeeper made some great saves. Sometimes it happens in football, and you need to take the learnings and move on. We have enough quality in the squad to achieve that, but tonight it didn’t go our way. 'We have a quick turnaround with a big game at the weekend, so we need to refocus and move on from this one.' Wins over Austria Vienna and Roma plus draws with Lyon and Hacken have seen us take eight points from a possible 12 in the league phase so far. A top-four finish will see us qualify automatically for the knockout stages of the competition, and Bompastor feels that we can't afford to drop any more points. 'I’m quite happy with the way we started the campaign. Tonight was a game where we couldn’t score a goal, but our ambition is still to finish in the top four. We have two games to go in this competition, so we’ll have to win them both and see what happens in the table.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特认为，在哈肯队与瑞典队陷入僵局后，她的球队未能以一场胜利击败哈肯队，但她强调了在周六对阵曼城的重要比赛中迅速前进的重要性。蓝军在希辛根球场除了进球之外几乎无所不包，两次击中门框，两粒进球被排除，总共射门 32 次，哈肯门将詹妮弗·法尔克 (Jennifer Falk) 因五次关键扑救而被授予本场最佳球员奖杯。防守方面，我们在联赛四场比赛中第四次保持不失球，但在这个晚上我们很不幸没有全取三分。然而，在女足冠军联赛中防守再次稳固的夜晚，主教练还是可以采取一些积极的措施。 “今晚在防守方面的表现很好，”邦帕斯托反映道。 “我们知道他们想对我们做什么：他们想利用攻防转换来伤害我们的后防线，而后卫们很好地处理了这些情况。 “在比赛的大部分时间里，我们都在控球方面占据主导地位。我们创造了很多机会，但今晚我们没能打进一球来赢得比赛。这是一个令人沮丧的结果。我们带着胜利的雄心来到这里。 “我们还击中了横梁，守门员做出了一些精彩的扑救。有时足球场上会发生这种情况，你需要吸取教训并继续前进。我们的阵容有足够的实力来实现这一目标，但今晚它并没有如我们所愿。 “周末我们有一场重要的比赛，所以我们需要重新集中注意力，继续前进。”战胜奥地利维也纳和罗马，加上战平里昂和哈肯，我们在联赛阶段的 12 分中拿下 8 分。进入前四名将让我们自动获得参加比赛淘汰赛的资格，邦帕斯特认为我们不能再丢分了。 “我对我们开始竞选活动的方式非常满意。今晚的比赛我们没有进球，但我们的目标仍然是进入前四。这场比赛我们还有两场比赛，所以我们必须赢得两场比赛，然后看看积分榜上会发生什么。”

news.title: Match report: Hacken 0-0 Chelsea
news.body_en: Chelsea had two goals ruled out and hit the woodwork twice as we battled to a 0-0 draw with Hacken, with the clean sheet preserved thanks to some excellent work from goalkeeper Livia Peng. The match began to the sound of a small but vociferous section of Hacken ultras, who were cheering their side on at the Hisingen Arena in Gothenburg. We kept 73 per cent of the ball during the opening 30 minutes, and despite creating multiple chances, could not convert. There was a feel of deja vu from last Saturday's second half against Everton as we peppered the opposition goal with shots - 21 in total by the 75th minute but still could not steer the ball across the line. But with 691 passes and 32 shots registered by the time the final whistle blew, Chelsea would depart Sweden with just one point in the bag. Sonia Bompastor took full advantage of our squad depth for this midweek trip to Gothenburg, making a total of six changes from the side that drew 1-1 with Everton last Saturday. Hannah Hampton made way for Peng in goal, while Sandy Baltimore, Kadeisha Buchanan, Erin Cuthbert, Katie McCabe and Manaka Matsukubo were replaced in the starting XI by Nathalie Bjorn, Veerle Buurman, Sjoeke Nusken, Lexi Potter and Alyssa Thompson. Our first opportunity came courtesy of Ellie Carpenter's run down the right channel, and her ball into the box was cleared before it could find Thompson in the crowded penalty area. Another cross from Carpenter earned a corner, and Wieke Kaptein had the ball in the back of the net from the resulting set piece, but the goal was ruled out for handball. Up the other end, Hacken broke, and only a superb top-handed save from Peng prevented the home side from taking the lead. It was a frenetic start to the game, and the next opportunity came our way. Buurman strode forward confidently out of defence and played a sideways ball to Kaptein. Quickly switching it to Carpenter, the wing-back advanced on goal but took an extra touch on the ball and ended up shooting into the side netting. We had the ball in the net once more just before the half-hour mark, when Melvine Malard broke through and slotted coolly into the bottom corner, but her attempt was ruled out for offside. Our passing was crisp, and we were creating plenty as we approached the break, and there was yet another close call when a cross-cum-shot from Lucy Bronze bounced off the top of the crossbar. The home side worked diligently to try to extinguish our chances, putting in 11 tackles in the first half alone. Carpenter had served up 10 crosses into the box during the opening 45 minutes, and the second half began with the Australian on the attack again; only a smart stop from former Liverpool goalkeeper Jennifer Falk kept her from putting us ahead. The chances kept coming, and in the 65th minute, Carpenter shot just wide of the right-hand post. And when a fast break saw an Alva Selerud attempt an audacious shot from outside the box, Peng delivered once more with an acrobatic save to push the ball round the post. The Blues managed a break of their own from the resulting corner, and having rounded the goalkeeper, Thompson's run took her just too wide to be able to convert, and her shot was cleared off the line. Substitute Matsukubo was the next player to be unlucky not to score as her close-range effort was saved by Falk. On 86 minutes, Maja Bodin broke through on another quick break. A last-ditch tackle from Buurman and quick reflexes from Peng preserved the clean sheet. As the fourth official indicated six minutes of added time, yet another cross from Carpenter came over into the box and Maika Hamano hit the top of the crossbar with her shot. The Blues couldn't have done much more in attack, but on this occasion, it just wasn't to be. We remain unbeaten and without a single goal conceded in our opening four matches in the UWCL. We move up to second in the league phase standings, pending the rest of the evening's later kick-offs. We return to Stamford Bridge on Saturday for our top-of-the-table Women's Super League clash with Manchester City. Tickets are still available, and you can secure your seat here. news.title: Cahill to take on Tottenham again in Legends match
news.title_zh: 卡希尔将在传奇赛中再次对阵托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: The number of former captains playing for Chelsea Legends at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 27 March rises to four today with the news that Gary Cahill is now part of the squad. The central defender led the Blues to FA Cup glory and won many more trophies and league titles as he amassed nearly 300 appearances for the Blues. Included among those was his heroic performance in Munich in 2012 as he succeeded in his fight to be fit for the triumphant Champions League final. Cahill joins John Terry, Katie Chapman and Cesar Azpilicueta as the trophy-winning skippers confirmed for the squad, while Eden Hazard and Oscar will be providing attacking flair and Claude Makelele will be reviving his midfield control. The Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match is scheduled for Easter Weekend and will raise funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities. The match will also provide support for Spurs in the Community. news.title: Romeo Lavia: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚：我的足球第一次
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia is the next Chelsea player to answer our quickfire questions about his early memories of the game. The in-form midfielder recalls life growing up in Belgium, and remembers how it felt to sign for the Blues back in 2023… What was the first game you attended? Anderlecht against Standard Liege. A big game, the biggest in Belgium. It was a top atmosphere. I must have been seven or eight. It was pretty cool. What was the first kit you owned? I think it was a Brazil shirt with Ronaldo on the back and number nine. Who was the first team you played for? My grassroots team was called Woluwe-Zaventem. She was called Natalie. She gave me the opportunity to move to an elite club, Anderlecht. Who was your first friend in football? His name is Hugo Masaki. He plays for UD Leiria in Portugal now. Who was the first team-mate you roomed with on an away trip? Who was your first team debut against? My first-team debut was with Man City against Wycombe Wanderers. What was the first goal you scored? That was for Southampton against Chelsea. I’m happy I have scored one for Chelsea now! When was the first time you were recognised in public? I must have been 15, when I was still at Anderlecht. It was in Brussels, and it was a very strange feeling! They must have been a big fan to know who I was. What was your first emotion after signing for Chelsea? Very proud, yeah. And I had all my family around, which made me even more grateful, happy, and excited.
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚是下一位回答我们有关他早期比赛记忆的快速问题的切尔西球员。这位状态良好的中场球员回忆起在比利时长大的生活，还记得 2023 年签约蓝军的感觉……您观看的第一场比赛是什么？安德莱赫特对阵标准列日。一场重要的比赛，是比利时最大的比赛。那是一种顶级的氛围。我那时应该七八岁了。太酷了。您拥有的第一个套件是什么？我认为这是一件巴西球衣，背面印有罗纳尔多，号码是 9。你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？我的草根团队叫做 Woluwe-Zaventem。她叫娜塔莉。她给了我转会到安德莱赫特精英俱乐部的机会。你在足球界的第一个朋友是谁？他的名字叫雨果·正崎。他现在效力于葡萄牙的UD Leiria。谁是你在客场旅行中第一个与你同住的队友？你的第一支球队首秀对阵谁？我的一线队首秀是在曼城对阵威科姆流浪者队的比赛中。你打进的第一个进球是什么？那是南安普顿对阵切尔西的比赛。我很高兴我现在为切尔西打进一球！你第一次在公共场合被认出是什么时候？当我还在安德莱赫特时，我大概15岁了。那是在布鲁塞尔，感觉很奇怪！他们一定是我的忠实粉丝，知道我是谁。加盟切尔西后你的第一感觉是什么？非常自豪，是的。还有我的家人都在身边，这让我更加感激、幸福和兴奋。

news.title: Nathalie Bjorn on why facing Hacken will be 'no walk in the park'
news.title_zh: 娜塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 解释为什么面对哈肯将“不像在公园散步”
news.body_en: Nathalie Bjorn is back in her native Sweden this week as we take on Hacken in the Women’s Champions League, with the defender hitting form at the perfect moment. Leaving behind last season’s injury battle, Bjorn enjoyed her first start for the Blues this season in the 6-0 WSL win over Charlton, leading the side out as captain. The day couldn’t have gone much better for Bjorn as she opened the scoring with a header after just three minutes at The Valley. As she explains when she sits down to talk to us ahead of the trip to Sweden, she’s feeling excited for the rest of the campaign. ‘It’s been good,’ Bjorn says. ‘I’m taking it day by day, and I’m very happy that my body is feeling good. 'It’s difficult coming back from a long-term injury, in terms of having the quality on the pitch and getting back to my old self. I know it will take time, so I’m trying to be open-minded and grateful that my body is doing what I want it to do. ‘I want to push my standards even higher, and I feel like I still have a few steps to go before I’m back to my prior self. But the season has been good. The team has been amazing and performed really well, and I think this is a very exciting season for us. ‘It was a really nice feeling to walk out with the armband and have the girls with me,' adds Nat. 'A proud moment for me, and obviously even better to score the goal. It was my first start in almost a year at Chelsea, which made it a really nice feeling. ‘We had loads of different goalscorers, and players who haven’t played as much this season got the chance to prove themselves. The game really showed the quality we have in the squad this year.’ Talking with Bjorn is an ideal opportunity for us to glean some insight into Tuesday night’s opponents and the wider Swedish league. From what she describes, the Blues supporters can expect a fascinating evening in Gothenburg. ‘Hacken are a good team,’ she explains. ‘Some of them are my team-mates in the national team. I played with their head coach before, and I know she’s a very good, very passionate coach. I played with their captain Anna Anvegard at Everton. I know them really well. ‘They are a hard-working side, and they’ve done well in Europe in previous seasons, so it’s not going to be a walk in the park for us. They also have a big supporter group at their home games, so I think it’s going to be an amazing atmosphere. I’m looking forward to it. ‘A few years back, the Swedish league was one of the biggest leagues in the world, with players such as Marta da Silva, Lotta Schelin and Christen Press,’ she tells us. 'There are loads of good Swedish players, too. ‘The number of players coming from the Swedish league to the English league proves that the quality there is really good. I took the step from the Swedish league to England myself. It’s a good league for preparing players to go out and play in Europe.' Bjorn moved to the Women’s Super League when she joined Everton back in 2021. We ask her about the difference between life in Scandinavia and England, and what she misses about home. ‘England is quite similar in a way, which is really nice,’ she smiles. ‘It feels like a home away from home. It’s easy to adapt to. Of course, there are different traditions and different types of food – I would say that’s maybe the biggest difference. ‘When I first came to England, it was an easy transition because we learn English in school. So with that and the culture being quite similar, it makes it really easy. ‘I miss the Swedish food. I miss Swedish pick and mix! Every time my parents or my siblings come over, I always ask them to bring some. I really miss Swedish cheese. We eat breakfast with hard bread and butter, and then we slice the cheese up. ‘But here we don’t have exactly the same assortment, or you buy slices already cut, and they’re quite thick, but I like them a bit thinner. It goes in phases, but right now, I miss the cheese and also liquorice!’ Bjorn will have a brief moment to sample those home comforts before focus turns to business. Today's task is returning to London with three more Champions League points.
news.body_zh: 娜塔莉·比约恩本周回到了她的祖国瑞典，我们将在女子冠军联赛中对阵哈肯，这位后卫在完美的时刻打出了状态。抛开上赛季的伤病之战，比约恩在 WSL 6-0 战胜查尔顿的比赛中以队长身份带领球队完成了本赛季的蓝军首次首发。对于比约恩来说，这一天再好不过了，她在山谷球场仅仅三分钟后就以头球首开纪录。正如她在前往瑞典之前坐下来与我们交谈时解释的那样，她对竞选活动的其余部分感到兴奋。 “这很好，”比约恩说。 “我每天都在服用，我很高兴我的身体感觉很好。 “从长期伤病中恢复过来，在球场上保持良好的状态并找回以前的自己是很困难的。我知道这需要时间，所以我努力保持开放的态度，并感激我的身体正在做我想做的事情。 “我想把自己的标准提高得更高，而且我觉得在回到以前的自己之前，我还有几步路要走。”但这个赛季表现不错。这支球队非常棒，表现也非常好，我认为这对我们来说是一个非常激动人心的赛季。纳特补充道：“带着臂章走出去，并让女孩们和我在一起，这种感觉真的很好。” “对我来说这是一个值得骄傲的时刻，显然进球更好。这是我在切尔西近一年来第一次首发，这让我感觉非常好。 “我们有很多不同的射手，本赛季出场次数不多的球员有机会证明自己。这场比赛确实展示了我们今年球队的实力。”与比约恩交谈是我们了解周二晚上的对手和更广泛的瑞典联赛的理想机会。根据她的描述，蓝军支持者可以期待在哥德堡度过一个迷人的夜晚。 “哈肯是一支优秀的团队，”她解释道。 “他们中的一些人是我在国家队的队友。我以前和他们的主教练一起打过球，我知道她是一位非常优秀、非常热情的教练。我在埃弗顿和他们的队长安娜·安维加德一起踢球。我非常了解他们。 “他们是一支勤奋的球队，前几个赛季他们在欧洲表现出色，所以这对我们来说并不是一件容易的事。他们在主场比赛中也有一个庞大的支持者群体，所以我认为这将是一个令人惊叹的氛围。我很期待。 “几年前，瑞典联赛是世界上最大的联赛之一，拥有玛塔·达席尔瓦、洛塔·谢林和克里斯滕·普雷斯等球员，”她告诉我们。 “瑞典也有很多优秀的球员。 “从瑞典联赛来到英格兰联赛的球员数量证明了那里的质量非常好。我自己从瑞典联赛来到了英格兰。这是一个很好的联赛，可以让球员为去欧洲踢球做好准备。”比约恩于 2021 年加盟埃弗顿后转投女子超级联赛。我们询问她斯堪的纳维亚半岛和英格兰的生活有何不同，以及她对家乡的思念。 “英格兰在某种程度上非常相似，这真的很好，”她微笑着说。 ‘感觉就像一个家外之家。很容易适应。当然，有不同的传统和不同类型的食物——我想说这可能是最大的区别。 “当我第一次来到英国时，这是一个很容易的过渡，因为我们在学校学习英语。因此，由于这一点和文化非常相似，这使得事情变得非常容易。 “我想念瑞典食物。我想念瑞典的挑选和混合！每次我的父母或兄弟姐妹过来时，我总是要求他们带一些。我真的很想念瑞典奶酪。我们吃早餐时会吃硬面包和黄油，然后把奶酪切成薄片。 “但我们这里没有完全相同的品种，或者你买的是已经切好的切片，它们很厚，但我喜欢薄一点。”它分阶段进行，但现在，我想念奶酪和甘草！”在焦点转向业务之前，比约恩将有短暂的时间品尝这些家庭舒适感。今天的任务是带着欧冠三分回到伦敦。

news.title: Bompastor on latest team news and needing to be at our best against Hacken
news.title_zh: Bompastor 了解最新的球队新闻，并需要在对阵哈肯的比赛中发挥最佳水平
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor feels that Tuesday night's UEFA Women's Champions League fixture against Hacken has come at exactly the right time to help Chelsea shake off Saturday's disappointing 1-1 draw with Everton in domestic action. The stalemate with the Toffees saw Sandy Baltimore put us in front with a header, but an unfortunate own goal from Lucy Bronze levelled the scores. And despite our best efforts in the second half, we couldn't put ourselves back in front. There's little time between Saturday afternoon's final whistle and Tuesday's 5.45pm kick-off (UK time) in Gothenburg, but Bompastor feels that it will be good to get back out on the pitch quickly to shake off the result against Everton. And aside from Naomi Girma and Lauren James, who were not part of the travelling squad, the head coach confirmed she has a full complement to pick from. 'All the other players are fit and available,' said Bompastor, before going on to discuss our impressive record in the Champions League, in which we have not conceded a single goal in our opening three league phase encounters. 'It’s important for us to stay in that good form, especially on the back of a disappointing result at the weekend. 'In this competition we also have ambitions, and right now we are in the top four. That’s the goal: we want to be in the top four and stay there. So we want to put in a good performance and get a good result tomorrow. Staying strong defensively, not conceding too much and keeping a clean sheet would be a good thing.' In a match where we had 65 per cent possession and fired 20 shots towards goal against Everton, the head coach said she was frustrated not to take all three points. But football moves on quickly, and Bompastor wants to take the opportunity to put in an improved display against Hacken. 'I think the frustration came from the result because we have ambitions, and dropping two points at home is never good, but it happens. The good thing with a quick turnaround is you analyse the game and give the players feedback, but you also need to move on. You need to focus on something new. We have a new game coming, in a new competition, so it’s the best thing for us in terms of moving on.' Hacken were crowned Swedish champions for the second year running last week, and won the inaugural Women’s Europa Cup last season. However, their Champions League campaign has been tougher, with defeats to Inter and Juventus followed by a 1-1 draw away at Paris FC, secured by a 93rd-minute equaliser. Bompastor believes those results haven’t reflected Hacken’s performances, and she warned of the threats they carry. 'Hacken's Champions League results didn’t necessarily reflect their performances on the pitch,' Bompastor explained. 'They have strengths and threats, especially in the attacking line, with speed and pace. So we will have to be really careful in the transitional moments of the game. 'For me, it’s important we find the right balance between focusing on ourselves and making sure we don’t give them many opportunities. They are playing at home, so they’ll want a good result, and we need to be at our best tomorrow.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特认为，周二晚上对阵哈肯的欧洲女子冠军联赛比赛来得正是时候，帮助切尔西摆脱了周六在国内比赛中令人失望的 1-1 战平埃弗顿的局面。在与太妃糖队的平局中，桑迪·巴尔的摩的头球帮助我们取得领先，但不幸的是露西·布朗泽的乌龙球将比分扳平。尽管我们在下半场尽了最大努力，但我们还是没能重新领先。从周六下午的终场哨声吹响到周二下午 5.45 分在哥德堡开球（英国时间）之间的时间很短，但邦帕斯特认为，尽快回到球场上摆脱对埃弗顿的比赛结果将是件好事。除了娜奥米·吉尔玛和劳伦·詹姆斯不在随行阵容之外，主教练确认她还有完整的阵容可供选择。 “所有其他球员都健康并且可以上场，”邦帕斯托尔说道，然后继续讨论我们在冠军联赛中令人印象深刻的记录，我们在联赛的前三阶段比赛中没有丢过一个球。 “对我们来说保持良好的状态很重要，尤其是在周末令人失望的结果之后。 “这次比赛我们也有雄心，现在我们已经进入前四了。这就是我们的目标：我们希望进入前四并保持在那里。所以我们希望明天有好的表现并取得好的结果。保持坚强的防守，不失太多，保持不失球将是一件好事。”在一场对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，我们控球率为 65%，并射出 20 次射门，主教练表示她对未能全取三分感到沮丧。但足球比赛进展很快，邦帕斯特希望借此机会在对阵哈肯的比赛中提高自己的表现。 “我认为沮丧来自于结果，因为我们有雄心，在主场丢两分从来都不是好事，但这种情况确实发生了。快速周转的好处是你可以分析游戏并向玩家提供反馈，但你也需要继续前进。你需要专注于新事物。我们即将迎来一场新的比赛，一场新的比赛，所以这对我们继续前进来说是最好的事情。”哈肯上周连续第二年加冕瑞典冠军，并在上赛季赢得了首届女子欧洲杯冠军。然而，他们的欧冠之旅更加艰难，先后输给国际米兰和尤文图斯，随后又客场1-1战平巴黎FC，并在第93分钟扳平比分。邦帕斯特认为这些结果并没有反映哈肯的表现，她警告说这些结果带来的威胁。 “哈肯的欧冠成绩并不一定反映他们在球场上的表现，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “他们有优势和威胁，尤其是在进攻线上，速度和节奏。所以我们在比赛的过渡时刻必须非常小心。 “对我来说，重要的是我们在关注自己和确保不给他们太多机会之间找到适当的平衡。他们是在主场比赛，所以他们想要一个好的结果，而我们明天需要发挥出最好的状态。”

news.title: Chelsea Women travelling squad confirmed for Hacken

news.body_en: A 23-player Chelsea squad has been confirmed for the Women's Champions League match away at Hacken. The Blues sit joint-second in the UEFA Women's Champions League table, with seven points earned from wins over Austria Vienna and Roma at home, plus a hard-fought goalless draw away at Lyon. Tomorrow's match, held at the Hisingen Arena in Gothenburg, kicks off at 6.45pm local time (5.45pm UK). You can listen to live commentary and follow minute-by-minute text updates in our Match Centre. Naomi Girma and Lauren James will not travel as both are ruled out through injury. Captain Erin Cuthbert joins the travelling squad for a European fixture for the first time this season after completing her recovery from injury. It's a big week for Chelsea as, following our trip to Sweden, we will return to domestic action with a game against Women's Super League leaders Manchester City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday at 1.30pm. You can buy tickets for that blockbuster clash here. Our next home European action is against French side Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane on 18 November. See below for the full list of players travelling to Sweden... Goalkeepers: Hannah Hampton, Livia Peng, Becky Spencer Defenders: Nathalie Bjorn, Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Veerle Buurman, Ellie Carpenter, Nelly Las, Katie McCabe Midfielders: Lola Brown, Erin Cuthbert, Giulia Dragoni, Wieke Kaptein, Sjoeke Nusken, Lexi Potter, Keira Walsh Forwards: Sandy Baltimore, Aggie Beever-Jones, Maika Hamano, Manaka Matsukubo, Melvine Malard, Alyssa Thompson

news.title: Chelsea Women's Constant Contact October Goal of the Month revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足十月持续接触十月最佳进球揭晓！
news.body_en: Maika Hamano's sublime strike against Tottenham Hotspur in the Women's Super League has been voted as our Constant Contact Goal of the Month for October! Hamano came on after half-time against Spurs, and she marked her appearance against her former loan club with a stunning swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. The replays showed just how much the ball moved once it had left her foot, and the goal certainly got the Blues fans off their seats at Stamford Bridge. Her strike was the clear winner among Blues fans, receiving 60 per cent of all votes cast. Lauren James' superb effort in the same game against Spurs at the Bridge finished second with 16 per cent, while Melvine Malard's shot from range against Crystal Palace received nine per cent and was ranked in third place.

news.body_en: Chelsea's UEFA Women's Champions League campaign continues as we travel to Sweden to face Hacken on Tuesday evening. The Blues are unbeaten in Europe this season and are yet to concede after three matches of the league phase. We will be looking for our first away win of the campaign as the Champions League returns to the top of the agenda in midweek. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Hacken against Chelsea Women, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Hacken takes place on Tuesday 10 November at Hisingen Arena, with kick-off scheduled for 5.45pm UK time (6.45pm local time). The match will be shown live in the UK on Disney+. As always, you can follow minute-by-minute updates in our Hacken vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. You can also follow through Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook and Instagram. Chelsea are yet to lose or concede in this season's Champions League, beating Austria Vienna 1-0 and Roma 2-0 at Plough Lane, either side of a goalless draw away at Lyon. That run has extended our record-breaking unbeaten streak in league phase and group stage fixtures to 27 games. Hacken, last season's Women's Europa Cup winners, arrive as newly crowned Damallsvenskan champions, having lost just once in 25 league games. However, in Europe, they are still looking for a first win, with defeats to Inter and Juventus followed by a 1-1 draw away at Paris FC. Chelsea are unbeaten in two previous meetings with Hacken, both in the group stage of the 2023/24 Women's Champions League. A goalless draw at Stamford Bridge was followed six days later by a 3-1 win in Gothenburg, with a goal from Sam Kerr and an Erin Cuthbert brace.

news.title: Xabi Alonso calls for consistency after ‘ups and downs’
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索呼吁在“起起落落”后保持稳定
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso knows there were positives and negatives from his Chelsea team’s performances since the October international break, but wants to see the Blues hitting our top level more consistently when we return from the latest one. We enter the November break – the last of this year, with the next interruption to the club football schedule not arriving until March 2027 – off the back of a loss, as a first-half penalty condemned us to a narrow 1-0 defeat away at Sunderland on Sunday. That is a repeat of the previous international window, in late September and early October, when we were beaten at Brentford in our final game leading into the break. Since then, results have been mixed. Strong wins over Bournemouth, Everton and Manchester United – bringing our first two Premier League clean sheets of the season in the process – were offset by our exit from the Carabao Cup in a penalty shoot-out at Liverpool and league defeats to Tottenham Hotspur and, now, Sunderland. It was that inconsistency in league results and performance which was on our manager’s mind when he was asked for his opinion on how this run of fixtures has gone for the Blues. ‘Three wins, two defeats, it could have been better,’ reflected Alonso. ‘It’s progress, but we want to be more consistent. ‘It was about finishing this block with a good feeling but, like the last block against Brentford, we lost. ‘For sure, it’s ups and downs, and we are still missing that consistency that is needed in the Premier League.' The good news is that Alonso, his staff, and those members of his squad who aren’t heading away to join their national teams in the coming days, now have time to plan and prepare to put that right in time for the Premier League’s return. That comes on Saturday 21 November, when Chelsea will host old rivals Leeds United at Stamford Bridge. We will be looking to get straight back to winning ways after this international break, just as we did last time around by thrashing Bournemouth 5-1 in west London on our return to the pitch. ‘The plan is to use the time with the players we have,’ Xabi added on his plans for the international break. ‘Some players will go on international duties, but we keep working.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索知道，自十月国际比赛日以来，他的切尔西队的表现有积极的一面，也有消极的一面，但他希望看到蓝军在最近一场比赛归来后能够更稳定地达到我们的顶级水平。由于一场失利，我们进入了 11 月份的休息期——今年的最后一次，俱乐部足球赛程的下一次中断要到 2027 年 3 月才会到来——上半场的点球让我们在周日客场以 1-0 险胜桑德兰。这是上一个国际比赛窗口的重演，九月底和十月初，当时我们在中场休息前的最后一场比赛中在布伦特福德被击败。从那时起，结果好坏参半。对阵伯恩茅斯、埃弗顿和曼联的强劲胜利——我们在英超联赛中取得了本赛季前两场不失球——但我们在卡拉宝杯中在利物浦的点球大战中被淘汰，以及联赛中输给托特纳姆热刺和现在的桑德兰，这些都抵消了我们的影响。当我们的主教练被问及对蓝军这轮比赛的进展有何看法时，他想到的正是联赛成绩和表现的不一致。 “三场胜利，两场失败，本来可以更好，”阿隆索反映道。 “这是进步，但我们希望更加一致。 “我们的目标是带着良好的感觉完成这个拦网，但就像对阵布伦特福德的最后一个拦网一样，我们输了。 “当然，这有起有落，我们仍然缺少英超联赛所需的一致性。”好消息是，阿隆索、他的工作人员以及他的球队中那些在未来几天不会前往加入国家队的成员，现在有时间计划和准备，以便在英超联赛回归之前及时做好准备。 11 月 21 日星期六，切尔西将在斯坦福桥迎战老对手利兹联。我们将寻求在国际比赛日结束后直接回到胜利之路，就像我们上次回到球场时在伦敦西部以 5-1 击败伯恩茅斯一样。 “我们的计划是利用与我们现有球员相处的时间，”哈维在谈到国际比赛日的计划时补充道。 “一些球员将继续履行国际职责，但我们会继续努力。”

news.body_en: The first cashback window for supporters who have sold general admission tickets on the ticket exchange will open tomorrow. You can use account credit from ticket sales towards future ticket purchases, including season ticket renewals, or you can withdraw the credit to a bank account during one of the season’s three dedicated withdrawal windows. The first withdrawal window of the 2026/27 season opens at 12pm on Tuesday 10 November and runs until 12pm on Monday 23 November. Please log in to your account on the ticketing portal and when the window is open: Select VIEW ACCOUNT MENU under the head and shoulders icon in the top right-hand corner Then select ACCOUNT CASHBACK, which will appear in the dropdown menu You can then enter your bank account details and the amount to transfer Once the details are entered, click on TRANSFER FUNDS When the process is complete, you will receive a TRANSFER SUCCESSFUL message on screen and an email confirmation of the cashback request If you look in your ACCOUNT HISTORY, you will see confirmation of the cashback request If you do not have a UK bank account Please complete the submission form, which can be accessed by clicking here and then email tickets@chelseafc.com during the above withdrawal window open period with proof of account for verification. If you would prefer your balance to remain in your account to be used towards future purchases, you do not have to take any action. Funds will be transferred to your nominated bank account within 10 working days of the window closing, provided your request has been successfully received. Before submitting your request, carefully check the bank account details and withdrawal amount. You cannot amend a request once it has been sent. news.title: Chelsea Diary: Big week for CFCW culminates in Man City showdown

news.body_en: European football and a huge domestic test for Chelsea Women headline the week ahead, while the men's team enter the final international break of 2026. Sonia Bompastor's side have two important fixtures to look forward to, beginning with a trip to Sweden in the Champions League before welcoming Manchester City to Stamford Bridge in the WSL. There will also be plenty to follow away from club football, with several Chelsea players representing their countries. Here are just some of the highlights to look out for across the next seven days… We begin the week by reflecting on our defeat to Sunderland, with post-match words from Xabi Alonso and Mike Penders as well as a full replay of the game. Attention will then turn towards Chelsea Women’s trip to play Hacken, starting with the first 15 minutes of their training session being broadcast live on the Chelsea Official App and website. Coverage will start at 10.45am. Later in the day, Bompastor and one of her players will be answering the media’s questions in Gothenburg. That press conference, at 6.45pm UK time, will also be shown live on our channels. We will also bring you news of which of our men’s players will be on international duty this window. Chelsea Women take on Hacken at the Hisingen Arena for a 5.45pm kick-off. We are searching for our third win in the competition this season, and Nathalie Bjorn will be previewing the fixture in her homeland in an exclusive interview. We will bring supporters all the latest team news and build-up ahead of the game, with live coverage, updates and reaction available on the Chelsea Official App and website. We’ll have further reaction and analysis from the game in Sweden, as well as the best of the action. There will be an exclusive interview with Romeo Lavia, so impressive in recent weeks, discussing his footballing firsts. The first of our international round-ups will include news of England’s game against Croatia at Wembley. Belgium and France are also in action. For Chelsea Women, the focus will firmly shift towards the weekend meeting with title rivals Manchester City. It is undoubtedly one of the standout fixtures in the WSL calendar, and we will carry words from several of our players about what having Stamford Bridge as our permanent home has been like. Bompastor will face the media to preview that game on Friday afternoon, and we will bring you the key talking points from her press conference, including the latest team news. Captain Erin Cuthbert also speaks exclusively to us ahead of the big match as we seek to reclaim top spot in the table. Kick-off at the Bridge is at 1.30pm - with tickets still available to buy – and our final preview beforehand is with Kadeisha Buchanan. The match will be broadcast live on BBC One in the UK, while supporters can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and reaction in our Chelsea Women vs Manchester City Match Centre. We will also bring supporters the best of the action after the final whistle, including a match report, highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players. As well as further reaction to the Manchester City game, we round off the week with further international action involving our men's players. England travel to Madrid to take on Spain in their second UEFA Nations League fixture of the November window, with Morgan Rogers hoping to feature for the Three Lions. We will also have a long read on the 30th anniversary of the signing of the great Gianfranco Zola.
news.body_zh: 欧洲足球和切尔西女足将在未来一周面临巨大的国内考验，而男队则进入 2026 年最后的国际比赛日。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队有两场重要的比赛值得期待，首先是欧洲冠军联赛的瑞典之旅，然后是在斯坦福桥迎战曼城的 WSL。俱乐部足球之外还有很多值得关注的事情，几名切尔西球员将代表自己的国家出战。以下是未来 7 天内需要关注的一些亮点……我们以哈比·阿隆索和迈克·彭德斯的赛后言论以及比赛的完整重播来回顾我们输给桑德兰的比赛开始本周。随后，注意力将转向切尔西女足对阵哈肯的比赛，从切尔西官方应用程序和网站上直播的前 15 分钟训练开始。报道将于上午 10.45 开始。当天晚些时候，邦帕斯特和她的一名球员将在哥德堡回答媒体提问。英国时间下午 6.45 举行的新闻发布会也将在我们的频道上直播。我们还将为您带来有关我们哪些男子球员将在这个窗口执行国际任务的消息。切尔西女足将于下午 5 点 45 分在希辛根体育场迎战哈肯。我们正在寻求本赛季比赛的第三场胜利，娜塔莉·比约恩将在她的祖国接受独家采访，预览这场比赛。我们将在比赛前为支持者带来所有最新的球队新闻和集结，并在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上提供现场报道、更新和反应。我们将从瑞典的比赛以及最佳比赛中得到进一步的反应和分析。罗密欧·拉维亚（Romeo Lavia）将接受独家采访，他在最近几周的表现令人印象深刻，讨论他的足球生涯第一次。我们的第一个国际综述将包括英格兰在温布利对阵克罗地亚的比赛的新闻。比利时和法国也在行动。对于切尔西女足来说，焦点将坚定地转向周末与争冠对手曼城的比赛。这无疑是 WSL 日历中最出色的比赛之一，我们将转述几位球员的心声，讲述以斯坦福桥作为我们永久主场的感受。邦帕斯特将于周五下午面对媒体预览这场比赛，我们将为您带来她新闻发布会上的要点，包括最新的球队新闻。队长艾琳·库斯伯特也在这场重要比赛前与我们进行了独家对话，因为我们正在寻求重新夺回积分榜的榜首位置。大桥的开赛时间为下午 1.30，门票仍可购买，我们将与卡黛莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 一起进行最后的预演。这场比赛将在英国的 BBC One 进行现场直播，而支持者可以在我们的切尔西女足对阵曼城比赛中心关注所有的赛前准备、确认的球队新闻、每分钟的更新和反应。我们还将在终场哨响后为球迷们带来精彩的比赛内容，包括比赛报告、亮点以及 Bompastor 和她的球员的反应。除了对曼城比赛的进一步反应之外，我们还以涉及我们男子球员的进一步国际行动来结束本周。英格兰将前往马德里，在 11 月份欧洲国家联赛的第二场比赛中迎战西班牙，摩根·罗杰斯希望代表三狮军团出场。我们还将长篇阅读伟大的詹弗兰科·佐拉签约 30 周年。

news.title: Mike Penders focused on ‘staying together’ after difficult Sunderland defeat
news.title_zh: 迈克·彭德斯在艰难击败桑德兰后专注于“团结一致”
news.body_en: Mike Penders did not hide from the disappointment and frustration felt in the Chelsea dressing room after Sunday’s loss at Sunderland. A tight contest at the Stadium of Light was decided by Enzo Le Fee’s first-half penalty. The Blues enjoyed plenty of possession and territory, especially after the break, but couldn’t create clear opportunities against a resolute Black Cats rearguard. Besides one outstanding save in the second period to deny Wilson Isidor, Penders didn’t have a great deal to do, either. But the damage had been done and one goal proved enough for Sunderland’s second league win of the season. ‘Very disappointed with the result,’ Penders said. ‘You know when you come here to their stadium that it will be a difficult game, and they fought very hard. ‘At one point, it went very fast from side to side. Sometimes we had control and, of course, in certain moments when you go higher up the pitch they will be very aggressive and the way they play is very difficult. ‘In the second half they dropped very low and had every man behind the ball, so we had a bit more control and we had to push. We had some chances, but it was difficult against 11 behind the ball to find the right spaces. We kept pushing, especially in the last 15 minutes, we kept dropping balls at them, but it wasn’t enough.’ With domestic action pausing for the international break, there is now a brief window to reset before we host Leeds on 21 November. For Penders, the key now is maintaining collective belief and building on the positive elements of recent performances ahead of our return to action later this month. ‘If you watch some of the last games, we played pretty well,’ said Penders. ‘The structure is getting better and it’s a pity that we have lost this game. ‘It’s a matter of staying together. I think we’ve had some good games, but after losing these games, we have to stick together. It’s the international break now, so we can calm our heads, and when we come back we need to all be motivated and go again.’
news.body_zh: 周日输给桑德兰后，迈克·彭德斯并没有掩饰切尔西更衣室里的失望和沮丧。光明球场上一场激烈的比赛因恩佐·勒费上半场的点球而决定胜负。蓝军拥有充足的控球权和地盘，尤其是在中场休息后，但无法在面对坚决的黑猫后卫时创造明显的机会。除了在第二节中扑出威尔逊·伊西多的一次出色扑救之外，彭德斯也没有太多事情要做。但伤害已经造成，一个进球足以帮助桑德兰赢得本赛季的第二场联赛胜利。 “对结果非常失望，”彭德斯说。 “你知道，当你来到他们的体育场时，这将是一场艰难的比赛，他们打得非常努力。 “有一次，它从一端移动到另一端速度非常快。有时我们有控制权，当然，在某些时刻，当你往前走的时候，他们会非常有侵略性，他们的比赛方式也非常困难。 “下半场他们的位置很低，每个人都在球后面，所以我们有更多的控制权，我们必须推动。我们有过一些机会，但面对 11 名后卫，我们很难找到合适的空间。我们一直在努力，特别是在最后 15 分钟，我们不断向他们扔球，但这还不够。”随着国际比赛日暂停国内比赛，在我们 11 月 21 日主场迎战利兹联之前，现在有一个短暂的重置窗口。对于彭德斯来说，现在的关键是保持集体信念，并在本月晚些时候恢复行动之前以近期表现的积极因素为基础。 “如果你看了最近的一些比赛，你会发现我们踢得很好，”彭德斯说。 ‘结构正在变得更好，遗憾的是我们输掉了这场比赛。 ‘这是一个待在一起的问题。我认为我们打出了一些精彩的比赛，但在输掉这些比赛之后，我们必须团结起来。现在是国际比赛日，所以我们可以冷静下来，当我们回来时，我们需要充满动力并再次出发。”

news.title: Alonso: We didn’t produce enough to deserve to win
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们的表现不足以赢得胜利
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso felt the Blues could have come away from Sunderland with a point with a bit more luck, but accepted we didn’t do enough to deserve more than that. We succumbed to a narrow 1-0 defeat at the Stadium of Light in a game ultimately decided by one first-half refereeing decision, which saw the home side awarded a first-half penalty that Enzo Le Fee converted. The Blues pushed hard for an equaliser to salvage a point in the second period, especially during the closing stages, when substitutes Geovany Quenda and Danny Welbeck both went close. However, Alonso was in no mood to make excuses after the final whistle, admitting his side hadn’t performed at the level he expects, particularly when it came to our attempts to break down the stubborn Sunderland defence after falling behind. ‘I would say there were situations that we could have defended better, situations that we could have got better advantages in attack, but the game was really even, really competitive,’ said our manager. ‘They were waiting for the chance – and they got it. After they took the lead, we were trying, but we were not producing much. The first goal is always important and today, when we were behind, we didn't produce enough. ‘It wasn't the best game. I think that we didn't deserve more than probably one point. The game was really close. ‘Not much happened, to be honest, just that action [for the Sunderland penalty]. We had the cross in the first half, the header from Morgan (Rogers), but we didn't produce enough to deserve to win. ‘We were against a low block. We missed a bit of patience and a bit of quality, creativity in the last third to create more chances. You need to be more consistent to move the ball from one side to the other, and we didn't do good enough.’ Alonso conceded that the absences of unavailable players could have influenced our performance, as Josh Acheampong was ruled out with a small issue on Saturday and the game was too soon for Emiliano Martinez to make his return. Jorrel Hato, Jamie Gittens, Reece James, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro also remain out. The Blues will now go into the international break hoping to get at least some of those players back for our next game against Leeds United on 21 November, even if Alonso made clear he expects better from the Blues, whoever is in the team. ‘There are situations,' he acknowledged. 'Yesterday Josh felt something and he was not fit to play. So we are shorter in options and we need to go through this time. ‘Even when we win, or when we lose, we miss some players that we have injured and for sure we are waiting to have them back because they are important. Now we need to use the time to recover them, but with the players we have, we have to get ready for the next one.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为，如果运气好的话，蓝军本可以从桑德兰带走一分，但他承认我们做得还不够，值得得到更多。我们在光明球场以 1-0 险胜，这场比赛最终是由上半场裁判的决定决定的，主队判给了上半场的点球，恩佐·勒费将球罚进。蓝军在第二节奋力扳平比分，尤其是在最后阶段，替补出场的乔瓦尼·昆达和丹尼·维尔贝克都险些扳平比分。然而，终场哨响后，阿隆索没有心情找借口，承认他的球队没有达到他预期的水平，特别是当我们在落后的情况下试图打破桑德兰顽强的防守时。 “我想说，在某些情况下我们本可以防守得更好，在某些情况下我们本可以在进攻中获得更好的优势，但比赛真的很均匀，很有竞争力，”我们的主教练说。 “他们在等待机会——而且他们得到了机会。”他们取得领先后，我们也在尝试，但成果并不多。第一个进球总是很重要，而今天，当我们落后时，我们的表现还不够。 ‘这不是最好的比赛。我认为我们只配得到一分。这场比赛非常接近。 “说实话，并没有发生什么事情，只是（对桑德兰的点球）那个动作。上半场我们接到了传中，摩根（罗杰斯）的头球攻门，但我们的表现不足以赢得胜利。 “我们反对低位。我们在最后三分之一失去了一点耐心、一点质量和创造力来创造更多机会。你需要更加稳定地将球从一侧转移到另一侧，而我们做得还不够好。”阿隆索承认，缺席的球员可能会影响我们的表现，因为乔什·阿奇姆蓬在周六因一个小问题而被排除在外，而这场比赛对于埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯来说还为时过早。乔雷尔·哈托 (Jorrel Hato)、杰米·吉滕斯 (Jamie Gittens)、里斯·詹姆斯 (Reece James)、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 和若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 也没有参加。蓝军现在将进入国际比赛日，希望至少能找回其中一些球员参加 11 月 21 日对阵利兹联的下一场比赛，即使阿隆索明确表示他对蓝军有更好的期望，无论队中是谁。 “有些情况，”他承认。 “昨天约什感觉到了一些东西，他不适合参加比赛。所以我们的选择比较少，我们需要经历这一次。 “即使我们赢了，或者输了，我们也会想念一些受伤的球员，我们肯定会等待他们回来，因为他们很重要。现在我们需要利用时间来恢复他们，但凭借我们现有的球员，我们必须为下一场比赛做好准备。”

news.title: Match report: Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：桑德兰 1-0 切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea fell to a narrow defeat at the Stadium of Light on Sunday as a first-half penalty secured Sunderland the points. We could easily have had a spot-kick of our own before Enzo Le Fee netted the only goal, with a foul on Cole Palmer adjudged to have taken place just outside the box. The margins were fine in a scrappy contest, and another decision went the home side’s way after Brian Brobbey and Levi Colwill came together in the box. Le Fee converted. Having led at half-time for the first time this season, Sunderland defended their advantage doggedly. We struggled to fashion clear chances, with the best headed over by sub Danny Welbeck in stoppage time. Xabi Alonso made a pair of changes to the team that started against Manchester United last weekend. Pep Chavarria came in for Josh Acheampong, who missed out entirely with what Alonso said was a ‘minor issue’. Further forward, Jordan Henderson returned at the club where he came through, with Estevao Willian making way. Henderson played as the most advanced of a midfield trio also containing Moises Caicedo and Romeo Lavia. Mike Penders continued in goal, with Emiliano Martinez deemed not quite ready to start after his jaw surgery. There was also a place on the bench for Aaron Anselmino for the first time this season. After an immaculately observed period of silence to mark Remembrance Sunday, play got underway with Chelsea defending the goal high behind which the 3,000-strong travelling support were housed. Our hosts were dealt an early blow when Granit Xhaka had to be withdrawn inside four minutes. A scrappy start was punctured by a good chance for Brobbey, who volleyed Chemsdine Talbi’s teasing cross wide from close range. Midway through the half, Palmer was chopped down by Luke O’Nien as he advanced into the box. The referee didn’t give a foul, but replays showed it clearly was one. The only question was whether it took place inside the box. It was a very tight call, and one that unfortunately didn’t go in our favour. We very nearly let out our frustrations at that decision by immediately taking the lead. An inviting cross by Palestra from the right flank was met by the rising Rogers, who couldn’t steer his header on target. Brobbey was proving a nuisance. He led a breakaway from Colwill inside his own half but Fofana did well to take him wide. When the shot arrived, it flew over the bar. However, there was no such reprieve on 35 minutes. Brobbey spun Colwill and having got the wrong side of our defender, went to ground. There wasn’t a lot in it, with both players having a hold of the other’s shirt, but the referee’s on-call decision of penalty stood. Le Fee sent Penders the wrong way from 12 yards. It stayed 1-0 until half-time and Alonso responded by bringing on Estevao for Colwill. Caicedo dropped back into central defence, and we now had another attacker on the pitch. With the Blues still finding time and space in the final third at a premium, Alonso made two more changes on the hour. Welbeck and Malo Gusto replaced Neto and Palestra, with the Frenchman making his 100th Premier League appearance. There were a couple of nearly moments for first Estevao and then Palmer as a pair of penetrative passes from Rogers prized the Sunderland backline open. With 15 to play, it needed a brave and big save from Penders to deny Wilson Isidor – not long on for Brobbey – after a loose ball fell to him six yards out. Geovany Quenda nearly scored with his first involvement, a left-footed strike that took a deflection and had Robin Roefs scrambling across his goal. There was plenty of late possession and territory for the Blues, and the chance to equalise came from the head of Welbeck in stoppage time. Unfortunately, his effort flew over the bar, and with it went our hopes of returning to London with something to show for our efforts. We go into the final international break of the season in fifth place in the Premier League table. The Blues host Leeds United on Saturday 21 November following the pause for international football. news.body_zh: 周日，切尔西在光明球场以微弱优势落败，桑德兰凭借上半场的点球锁定了积分。在恩佐·勒费攻入唯一进球之前，我们本可以轻松获得一个点球，因为科尔·帕尔默在禁区外犯规。在一场激烈的比赛中，比分还算不错，而在布莱恩·布罗比和利维·科尔威尔在禁区内齐心协力后，主队又做出了另一个决定。勒费皈依了。桑德兰本赛季首次在半场领先，但他们顽强地捍卫了自己的优势。我们努力创造明确的机会，补时阶段替补丹尼·维尔贝克头球破门。哈维·阿隆索对上周末对阵曼联的首发阵容做出了一些调整。佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria）替换了乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong），后者因阿隆索所说的“小问题”而完全错过了比赛。再往前走，乔丹·亨德森回到了他出身的俱乐部，埃斯特沃·威廉让位。亨德森是莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和罗密欧·拉维亚中场三人组中最先进的球员。迈克·彭德斯继续守门，埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在下巴手术后被认为尚未准备好首发。亚伦·安塞尔米诺（Aaron Anselmino）本赛季首次在替补席上占有一席之地。在周日的阵亡将士纪念日默哀一段时间后，比赛开始了，切尔西队防守着球门，球门后有 3,000 名客场支援。当格兰尼特·扎卡（Granit Xhaka）不得不在四分钟内撤回时，我们的东道主很快就受到了打击。布罗比（Brobbey）的一次好机会打破了开局不利的局面，他近距离将切姆斯丁·塔尔比（Chemsdine Talbi）的挑衅传中凌空抽射偏出。半场中段，帕尔默突入禁区时被卢克·奥尼恩砍倒。裁判没有判犯规，但回放显示这显然是犯规。唯一的问题是它是否发生在盒子里。这是一个非常紧迫的决定，不幸的是，这个决定对我们不利。我们几乎立即带头发泄了对这一决定的不满。帕莱斯特拉从右翼传中，罗杰斯接住了起身的罗杰斯，但他的头球未能击中目标。事实证明，布罗比很讨厌。他在本方半场内突破科尔威尔，但福法纳出色地将他带出边路。当射门到来时，它飞过了横梁。然而，35分钟后并没有出现这样的缓刑。布罗比（Brobbey）旋转了科尔威尔（Colwill），并在我们的防守者的错误一侧，倒地。虽然事情并不多，两名球员都抓住了对方的球衣，但裁判的点球决定仍然有效。勒费从 12 码处将彭德斯送出错误的方向。直到半场结束，比分一直保持在1-0，阿隆索做出回应，为科尔威尔换下埃斯特沃。凯塞多回撤到中卫，现在我们场上又多了一名攻击手。由于蓝军仍然在进攻三分之一中寻找宝贵的时间和空间，阿隆索在这一小时内又做出了两次改变。维尔贝克和马洛·古斯托取代了内托和帕莱斯特拉，这是法国人第100次在英超联赛中出场。埃斯特沃（Estevao）和帕尔默（Palmer）都有几次险些进球的机会，罗杰斯（Rogers）的两次渗透性传球打开了桑德兰的后防线。比赛还剩 15 场，潘德斯在 6 码外接到一个松散的球落在威尔逊·伊西多 (Wilson Isidor) 身上后，他需要勇敢而大力的扑救才将球挡出——布罗比 (Brobbey) 很快就扑出了他的球。乔瓦尼·昆达（Geovany Quenda）第一次出场就差点进球，他的左脚射门发生偏转，罗宾·罗夫斯（Robin Roefs）争先恐后地冲过球门。蓝军在最后时刻拥有充足的控球权和地盘，扳平比分的机会来自维尔贝克在伤停补时阶段的头球。不幸的是，他的努力飞过了标准，我们带着一些东西来展示我们的努力的希望也随之消失了。我们以英超积分榜第五名的成绩进入本赛季最后的国际比赛日。 11 月 21 日星期六，国际足球比赛暂停后，蓝军将主场迎战利兹联队。 切尔西（4-3-3）：彭德斯； Palestra (Gusto 62)、Fofana、Colwill (Estevao h/t)、Chavarria (Quenda 79)；拉维亚、凯塞多 (c)、亨德森 (Emegha 87)；帕尔默、内托（维尔贝克 62）、罗杰斯 未上场替补：沙曼-洛、安塞尔米诺、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利 黄牌 科尔威尔 35、内托 55、凯塞多 76 桑德兰（4-2-3-1）：罗夫斯；穆尼耶、穆基勒、奥内因、雷尼尔多；萨迪基、扎卡 (c) (Ahoka 4)；休姆、勒费 (Rigg 88)、塔尔比 (Angulo 88)；布罗比 (Isidor 67) 未上场替补：埃尔博格、丹索、梅塔莉、福法纳、图铁洛夫。得分手勒费 36 黄牌 阿霍卡 21、莫尼耶 50、布罗比 53、奥尼恩 90、安古洛 90+4

news.title: Premier League 2 report: Tottenham Hotspur 1-3 Chelsea Cobham Next Gen
news.title_zh: 英超联赛 2 报告：托特纳姆热刺 1-3 切尔西科巴姆下一代
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen leapfrogged Tottenham Hotspur into second in the Premier League 2 table after a Harrison McMahon goal and a brace from Chizaram Ezenwata sealed a 3-1 win. It didn’t take the Blues long to take the lead, with McMahon scoring his second goal in as many matches by rounding goalkeeper Samual Archer and finishing after being put through one-on-one by Reggie Watson. Ezenwata doubled our advantage before the interval with his seventh goal of the season across all competitions for the Blues. We defended well for much of the second period, but Spurs pulled a goal back with 14 minutes to play when James Rowswell found the net. Despite late pressure from the hosts, we made sure of all three points when Ezenwata struck his second in stoppage time to seal victory. We exploited Tottenham’s high backline from the off, and Sol Gordon had an opportunity inside five minutes. A good ball forward from Calvin Diakite put the Blues winger through, but Archer saved well to turn the ball behind for a corner. It proved only a momentary reprieve for the home side as we soon broke the deadlock. Watson played a long ball over the top to McMahon, who remained composed to take the ball around the goalkeeper and slot home. We continued to probe the Tottenham defence across the remainder of the opening 45 minutes, although the hosts had chances of their own and Freddy Bernal produced a couple of smart stops in the Chelsea goal. Shortly before the interval, Gordon again came close. The Blues winger beat the Spurs' offside trap, raced into the box and aimed a shot toward the far post. Gordon's attempt beat Archer but was cleared off the line, and while Leo Cardoso was there for the follow-up, he was also denied. Three minutes before the interval, however, our second arrived. It was somewhat straightforward as Bernal hit a long pass into the Tottenham half and Ezenwata manoeuvred his way beyond the last defender and confidently finished beyond Archer. After the break, we kept pushing and came close to extending our advantage from corners, with Olutayo Subuloye asserting his dominance in the penalty area. Corners from Watson found the head of Subuloye repeatedly, with the Blues skipper consistently overpowering his marker, but he couldn't divert his attempts on target. Ezenwata also came close, utilising his excellent hold-up play to manufacture an opportunity. The Chelsea striker had his back to goal when he received possession, but created half a yard to get his shot off. Unfortunately, it curled too late and went just wide of the far post. Tottenham’s skipper, Roswell, halved the deficit from a set piece with 76 minutes left on the clock. Yet it was the Blues who had the final say in this derby. As the game entered additional time, Tottenham earned a free kick which they opted to take quickly. Substitute Harrison Bettoni reacted quickest to intercept the ball and get a shot away. His attempt was too powerful for Archer, who palmed the ball back out to Ezenwata. The Blues striker made no mistake and thumped a shot into the back of the net to put the game to bed and ensure all three points returned to Cobham. Our 3-1 win on derby day means that we are up to 16 points in PL2 after seven matches. We have leapfrogged Spurs and now sit in second position. Cobham Next Gen are back in PL2 action on Friday 27 November following the international break, when we face Norwich City at the Avant Training Centre. The game gets underway at 7pm GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription.
